propositions: Git 2.38+ floor is not currently declared or enforced for contributors and CI, allowing under-floor clients to run tests that require git merge-tree --write-tree capability.
The two-clone enrichment regression (bug 8185) uses git merge-tree --write-tree but has no version guard, causing potential silent failures on Git versions below 2.38.
A runtime skip guard would allow the regression test to be silently omitted on older clients, creating vacuous test coverage similar to the 34c2 pagination guard and 8a5e skip guards.

The Git version floor must be explicitly declared in a single source of truth, enforced with a clear failure message at pytest session start that names the required version and capability, and documented consistently across contributor guides and CI workflows.
The enforcement must be fail-closed (aborting the entire session, never skipping) to prevent the regression test from becoming vacuous through module splits or renames.
